analysis:
Reviewed both batch analyses against the replayed patches and metadata. The combined change removes console-only lint/build hooks (.githooks/pre-commit base 16–27; pre-push base 35–54), /console-ui dependency maintenance (.github/dependabot.yml base 3–28), the console CI route/job (.github/workflows/ci.yml base 37, 637–658), and its reusable workflow outputs (component-changes.yml base 8–9, 22). These removals agree across the supplied workflow patches; no retained consumer of the console output is shown. AGENTS.md base 42–56 and 64–69, CONTRIBUTING.md base 16–26 and 36–57, and SKILL.md base 10–18 remove console-retention/tooling references and move the telemetry-mirror reference to platform ownership.
No supplied executable change alters provider authorization or final handoff (TB-002/TB-011, T-052/T-053), artifact qualification (A-017/T-054), encrypted prompt transport (A-001/T-008), cache isolation (T-041), billing, inference, fan authority or add-on admission. Removing console checks does not itself establish an exploitable regression or a new provider trust claim. The patches do not independently establish the status of unchanged provider gates.
The local migration questions remain unresolved: confirm that this repository's console no longer supplies an active build/hosting dependency, that any retained consumers of the removed workflow outputs are migrated, and that security-relevant telemetry/fixture coverage is preserved where needed. An active deployment or missing replacement control cannot be inferred from documentation deletions, so these are integration contracts, not findings. Replay omits 15 previously reviewed units and contains no console retirement/deployment source or replacement test evidence; deeper review is needed to resolve that material scope limit. Canonical definitions were indexed with selected details only.
